## Checklist before requesting a review
- [ ] I have run the `npm run lint` command, and fixed any reported issues
- [ ] I have run the `npm run format` command, and fixed any reported issues
- [ ] I have run the `npm run format-docs` command, and fixed any reported issues
- [ ] Documentation is updated to reflect my changes
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
